basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a 27-year-old graphic designer currently residing in Leeds, UK. I'm passionate about fantasy art and spend my weekends exploring the local countryside for inspiration. I'm a night owl and do most of my online browsing after midnight. In my downtime, I love experimenting with new recipes, especially Indian cuisine, which I picked up from my college roommate who was from Mumbai. When I'm not working or cooking, you'll find me binge-watching sci-fi series or participating in online fantasy vision contests. I'm single and not actively looking, preferring to focus on personal growth and hobbies for now.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Graphic Design from the University of Leeds and have been working in the field for about 5 years. I started teaching myself digital painting techniques through online tutorials and have become quite adept at using software like Photoshop and Procreate. My interest in fantasy art and design stems from childhood, where I was an avid reader of fantasy novels and enjoyed creating my own worlds through drawing.
